questions.question: How do you greet someone in English?
questions.explanation: "Hello!" or "Hi!" is used to greet someone. "How are you?" asks how they are.

questions.question: What do you say when you receive a gift?
questions.explanation: We say "Thank you!" when we receive something. It shows we are grateful.

questions.question: Hva betyr "Nice to meet you"?
questions.explanation: "Nice to meet you" is what we say when meeting someone for the first time.

questions.question: What do you say when leaving?
questions.explanation: We say "Goodbye!" or "See you later!" when leaving.

questions.question: When you want something politely, you say:
questions.explanation: We use "please" to ask for things politely: "Can I have some water, please?"
